_readme: Settings for working ON THE HARNESS ITSELF — not the policy a scaffolded app gets, and not this project's security posture.

A scaffolded app is governed by template/base/.claude/settings.json plus the PreToolUse guard hooks (the pure-data rule table in .claude/hooks/lib/guard-rules.mjs). Those hooks are the deterministic layer; a permissions file is convenience, and it is not installed here because this repo is the harness, not a consumer of it.
So this file is deliberately permissive: routine work on the machinery never prompts. Only truly irreversible or outward-destructive actions sit in ask/deny.
Scratch-tree cleanup under /private/tmp stays prompt-free; recursive deletes aimed at the home tree or the repo cwd prompt first.
FORKING THIS TEMPLATE: review this file before your first agent turn — you inherit it, and you may want a tighter default than the one the upstream maintainer runs.
